features.description: Add bitwise operator builtins (xor, bitAnd, bitOr, shiftLeft, shiftRight, bitwiseNot) and fork ai-coding-lang-bench with AILANG config
acceptance_criteria: Bitwise XOR, AND, OR, NOT, shift builtins pass unit tests
Operators parse correctly with C/Go precedence (precedence_test.go)
FNV-1a hash function compiles and runs in AILANG
make test and make lint clean
Fork exists with AILANG language entry
extra_prompt contains current ailang prompt output
Wrapper script makes ./minigit executable with AILANG backend
features.notes: Bitwise operators fully implemented across 15+ files (~567 LOC) with C-standard precedence bands. charCode builtin added for FNV-1a hash. Fork at sunholo-data/ai-coding-lang-bench with 4 AILANG prompt strategy variants (zero-shot, cli, spec, guided). Wrapper script pattern documented in extra_prompt — Claude Code creates it during each trial.

features.description: Run 20 mini-git trials with AILANG via the forked benchmark, collect per-trial metrics
acceptance_criteria: 20 v1 trials completed with metrics (time, cost, LOC, pass/fail per test)
Results directly comparable to published Ruby/Python/JS/Go/Rust/Haskell data
Raw data saved for reproducibility
Summary table of AILANG vs top-5 languages
features.notes: Even 0% pass rate is valid — failure analysis drives gap design docs

features.description: Adapt leetgptsolver LeetCode problems to our eval harness format and run with AILANG across 3 models x 4 prompt strategies
acceptance_criteria: Problem adapter converts LeetCode problems to AILANG eval format
Exclusion list documented with reasons (e.g., requires mutable hash map)
At least 40 problems pass filtering (expressible in AILANG)
All 4 prompt strategies tested across 3 models
Results comparable to published Python/Java/Rust/Elixir pass rates
features.notes: Uses their problem dataset with our eval harness since LeetCode judge can't run AILANG

features.description: Analyze cross-track results, identify failure modes, create design docs for every identified gap
acceptance_criteria: Pass rate comparison table: AILANG vs 5+ other languages
Cost comparison table: AILANG vs published data
Failure mode taxonomy with counts and examples
Design doc created for each major gap category (minimum 2, expected 3-5)
Each gap design doc includes concrete examples from benchmark failures
Top-3 recommendations for improving AILANG AI-friendliness
CHANGELOG.md updated with results summary
features.notes: Gap design docs are the primary deliverable — benchmarks exist to identify them
